STORM.reason_localised: Your booked 22:45 shuttle is cancelled by the storm. The taxi rank is covered, step-free, and you'll be away before 23:00.

alternatives.action: Take the covered ramp to Gate D and wait at the Batman Ave shelter for the 23:20 accessible shuttle.

alternatives.reason_localised: Closest to your booked shuttle. The shelter is covered, but you wait longer.

alternatives.action: Go to Gate D and take an accessible taxi from 23:30.

TRAIN_SAND_25.action: Leave now via Gate A for your booked 22:45 accessible shuttle.

alternatives.action: Take the covered ramp to Gate D and an accessible taxi at 22:50.

alternatives.text_localised: Take the covered ramp to Gate D and an accessible taxi at 22:50.

alternatives.action: Take the covered ramp to Gate D for the 23:20 backup accessible shuttle.

alternatives.action: Take the covered ramp to Gate D and an accessible taxi at 23:30.

alternatives.reason_localised: Calmest and covered, but the longest wait and you pay a fare. Leave by 23:14.

SHUTTLE_FULL.reason_localised: The 22:45 shuttle is full. The 23:20 backup leaves from the same covered stop, and the crowd will have cleared.

alternatives.action: Leave now via Gate D for an accessible taxi at 22:50.
alternatives.reason: Gets you away 30 minutes earlier, but you leave into the exit crowd and pay a taxi fare.
alternatives.text_localised: Leave now by the covered ramp to Gate D. Accessible taxis from 22:50, 2 minutes from the gate.
alternatives.reason_localised: Home sooner, but busier路 and a taxi fare instead of your shuttle.

alternatives.action: Go via Gate D and take an accessible taxi at 23:30.
alternatives.reason: Latest, calmest option, all covered and step-free, if the 23:20 shuttle also fills.
alternatives.text_localised: Take the covered ramp to Gate D and wait at the covered taxi rank for 23:30.
alternatives.reason_localised: A calm backup if the 23:20 shuttle fills. All covered and step-free.

alternatives.text_localised: Take the covered ramp to Gate D and an accessible taxi from 22:50.

alternatives.text_localised: Covered ramp to Gate D, then the 23:20 accessible shuttle from the covered shelter.
alternatives.reason_localised: Shaded and step-free, no hurry. But you wait longer and the crowd leaves before you.

alternatives.action: Take the covered ramp to Gate D and an accessible taxi from 23:30.

SET_RIVER_30.reason_localised: The late set means your 22:45 shuttle has gone. This covered, step-free route gets you to the 23:20 backup run. A volunteer will meet you.
